name: Dragon Shelter
summary: 奇幻世界里的农场经营游戏，2026 年 9 月 24 日上架，Wild Forest Studio 开发、Curve Games 发行，分类为休闲／独立／模拟。商店 AI 披露把生成式 AI 限定在本地化与翻译，并写明全部译文经开发者复核编辑；同一句还否认使用 AI 生成美术、音频与游戏内实时生成。本站据此把翻译登记为已使用，把美术、音乐、语音、游戏内实时生成登记为披露明确否认的未使用，代码、文本创作与营销三项记为披露未说明。所有结论都来自开发者自述，未经独立审计。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 同一句否定还包括 in-game live generation，即游戏进行中没有实时生成内容；披露另有 localization 一句说明 AI 只在开发期的翻译环节参与。
aiAreaNotes.code: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。
aiAreaNotes.art: 披露以否定句写明不使用 AI 生成的美术：No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used.。这是开发者自述，未经独立审计。
aiAreaNotes.music: 同上否定句里的用词是 audio，未单列音乐；本站按该词把音乐登记为未使用，同时保留这只是开发者自述、未经独立审计的限定。
aiAreaNotes.voice: 同上否定句里的用词是 audio，未单列语音；本站按该词把语音登记为未使用，同时保留这只是开发者自述、未经独立审计的限定。
aiAreaNotes.writing: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。
aiAreaNotes.translation: 披露原文把生成式 AI 限定在本地化/翻译（only to assist with localization/translation），并补一句 All localized text is reviewed and edited by the developer.，即译文由开发者复核编辑。
aiAreaNotes.marketing: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI is used only to assist with localization/translation. All localized text is reviewed and edited by the developer. No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used.

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 277）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: GameAICheck 本作条目：第三方模型判词加商店披露转录
sources.excerpt: The disclosure limits AI to localization/translation, which is a supporting task, not shipped game content. No AI art, audio, or live generation is declared. The developer has one recent release and 328 reviews, showing a normal production cadence.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Wild Forest Studio，发行商 Curve Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 277，仅覆盖首页），首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有相关帖需要读取。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记该次响应的 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源：GameAICheck 本作条目把披露转录为翻译单项，并给出由 deepseek-flash 生成的“Minor AI · solid production”判词与开发商产出统计（一款近期作品、328 条评论）；这些是该站的模型判断与统计，不构成独立核实，本站不采纳其判词，只登记为第三方读法。其余 5 条为本作商店页、官方发布预告视频、一个 TikTok 条目（标题指向另一款作品 Cloudscrapers）、一个 Steam 鉴赏家列表页（URL 的 appid 是 4840950）与一个 Facebook 小组帖，均无独立于商店披露的信息或无法逐字核验，未登记为来源。四个否定领域只有开发者自述可依，且披露的用词粒度粗于本站的八领域：art 对应原文的 art，music 与 voice 共用原文的 audio 一词，ingame 对应 in-game live generation，本站在对应领域说明里写明这一映射，不做超出原文的推断。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI is used only to assist with localization/translation. All localized text is reviewed and edited by the developer. No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-04 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A fantasy farming sim released on Sep 24, 2026, developed by Wild Forest Studio and published by Curve Games, filed under Casual, Indie and Simulation. The Steam AI disclosure confines generative AI to localisation and translation, adds that every localised line was reviewed and edited by the developer, and denies the use of AI-generated art, audio or in-game live generation. This site records translation as used on that wording, records art, music, voice and live in-game generation as not used because the developer states so, and records code, writing and marketing as areas the disclosure does not address. Every finding rests on the developer own statement and none of it has been independently audited.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the complete English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Wild Forest Studio, publisher Curve Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 277, first page only), where no topic matches the AI keyword search, so no thread needed reading. This title was searched once, that one response holds 6 results and 1 raw source was read: the GameAICheck entry for this game transcribes the disclosure as translation only and prints an AI judgment produced by deepseek-flash plus its own publisher statistics (one recent release, 328 reviews); that is that site model output and its own counting, not independent verification, so this site logs it as a third-party reading and does not adopt the judgment. The other 5 results were the store page for this game, the official launch trailer, a TikTok item whose title belongs to a different game (Cloudscrapers), a Steam curators page whose appid is 4840950 and a Facebook group post; none carries information independent of the store disclosure or cannot be quoted verbatim, so none is registered as a source. The four negative findings rest on the developer statement alone, and the disclosure wording is coarser than the eight areas used here: art maps to the word art, music and voice both map to the single word audio, and live in-game generation maps to in-game live generation. Each area note records that mapping instead of extending it.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: The denying sentence also covers in-game live generation, so no content is generated while the player is playing, according to the developer. This has not been independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.code: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
aiAreaNotes.art: The disclosure denies AI-generated art outright: No AI-generated art, audio, or in-game live generation is used. This is the developer own statement and has not been independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.music: The same denying sentence uses the single word audio and does not name music separately; this area is recorded as not used on that word, with the developer statement caveat intact.
aiAreaNotes.voice: The same denying sentence uses the single word audio and does not name voice acting separately; this area is recorded as not used on that word, with the developer statement caveat intact.
aiAreaNotes.writing: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
aiAreaNotes.translation: The disclosure limits generative AI to localisation and translation, written as Generative AI is used only to assist with localization/translation, and adds that all localised text was reviewed and edited by the developer.
aiAreaNotes.marketing: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
